lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: There is an election coming. Six weeks from today.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: In Alupotha, this means several things. Mahinda Bandara will put his face on everything. The WhatsApp group will go quiet for approximately two minutes and then make up for it.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: I have voted in every election since 1983. Not because everything went perfectly. Mostly because it did not.

lines.speaker: Aunty Soma
lines.text: Someone new is coming to town this time. Maybe that is you.
